samples.summary: New `useDocumentsPath` hook is scoped to `app/files/` although the exact same "document's workspace slug → first workspace slug → /documents" fallback is inlined in at least five sibling detail routes (`notes-detail.tsx:76`, `board-detail.tsx:51`, `document-detail.tsx:189`, `docs-detail.tsx:107`, `slides-detail.tsx:114`). The repo has a canonical `packages/frontend/src/hooks/` directory for cross-feature hooks; putting it there (and using it in those five call sites, or at least making it importable) would fit the repo's reuse expectation instead of creating a sixth copy of the rule that only two files can share.
samples.evidence: use-documents-path.ts:20 `workspaces.find((w) => w.id === workspaceId)?.slug ?? workspaces[0]?.slug` duplicates notes-detail.tsx:76 `const fallbackSlug = workspaceSlug ?? workspaces[0]?.slug;` + :81 `navigate(fallbackSlug ? \`/w/${fallbackSlug}\` : "/documents")`

samples.summary: The Esc handler is a bare `window` keydown listener guarded only against INPUT/TEXTAREA/contenteditable, so Esc pressed while the image layout's `ShareDialog` (or any Radix overlay/menu) is open will both dismiss the overlay and navigate away from the viewer. The design-doc paragraph only claims the rename-field case is handled; the modal case is an unaddressed gap in the stated "Esc leaves the viewer" semantics.
samples.evidence: image-viewer.tsx:113-130 window keydown → `else if (e.key === "Escape" && onClose) onClose();` with no open-dialog/overlay check; file-detail.tsx:148 mounts `<ShareDialog documentId={documentId} />` in the same layout.

samples.summary: The hook has no loading distinction: while the `["workspaces"]` query is in flight it returns `/documents`. Esc or the back button pressed in that window navigates the user to the workspace-less list rather than the document's workspace list the design doc promises, and `FileShell`'s not-found redirect inherits the same race (it previously had it too, so this is pre-existing, but the hook is the natural place to fix it, e.g. by returning `undefined` until settled and no-oping the back action).
samples.evidence: `const { data: workspaces = [] } = useQuery(...)` then `return slug ? \`/w/${slug}\` : "/documents";` — empty-array default is indistinguishable from "user has no workspaces".

samples.summary: The back-to-list affordance is added only to `ImageFileLayout`; `PdfFileLayout` and `GenericFileLayout` share the same `/f/:id` shell and `FileShell.headerLeading` slot but get no back button, so the header's leave affordance is inconsistent across the route the shell was extracted to unify. If issue #840 is about "can't get out of a file viewer" generally, the pdf/file types are left unfixed; if it is image-only, this is fine.
samples.evidence: file-detail.tsx:139 `headerLeading={<BackToDocumentsButton onClick={close} />}` appears only inside `ImageFileLayout`; `PdfFileLayout` (line 94) and `GenericFileLayout` (line 171) pass no `headerLeading`.
